title: The Minimax Cost of Smoothness in Fully First-Order Stochastic Bilevel Optimization
summary: We study the sample complexity of finding a point with expected hypergradient norm at most $ε>0$ in nonconvex--strongly-convex stochastic bilevel optimization using fresh, globally unbiased first-order samples with bounded variance. For lower-variable smoothness order $p\ge1$, F$^2$SA-$p$ achieves $\widetilde O(pε^{-4-2/p})$ (Chen et al., 2026), but necessity of the exponent $4+2/p$ was open.
